name: Alex Rivera — Ecommerce Email Studio

agent.name: LeadSniper
agent.description: an AI prospecting agent that finds founder-run Shopify brands, verifies each store and a reachable email, and drafts the outreach in your voice.

icp.summary: Founder-run ecommerce / DTC brands on Shopify (or similar) that are actively selling in English-speaking markets (US, UK, AU, CA), established enough to be doing real revenue with real website traffic, and would benefit from stronger Klaviyo email marketing. The standout signal is brands that have appeared on Shark Tank (US) or Dragons' Den (UK). Founder-led SMB brands, not mass-market incumbents.
bad_fit: stores with no real products, revenue, or traffic
marketplace-only sellers (Amazon/Etsy only) with no real DTC store
huge mass-market incumbents past the founder-run SMB stage
brands that are dead, dormant, or acquired into a large parent

voice.greeting: Hey {first}, how are you? I hope business is good these days.
voice.intro: I am Alex, an ecommerce email specialist who turns Shopify email into a real revenue channel, handling the flows, campaigns, and copy end to end so founders do not have to.

sector_lines.beauty: Most Shopify brands I meet are leaving real money in their email, usually in the welcome, abandoned cart, and post-purchase flows that quietly run in the background. I set those up properly and write campaigns that sound like your brand, so email becomes a channel you can count on without you having to manage it.
